name: undo-button
title: Undo Button
description: A button that acts at once, then holds the real commit back for a short undo window with a draining bar and a Ctrl/Cmd+Z shortcut.

props.name: doneLabel
props.description: The same action in the past tense.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon in the idle state. Decorative.

props.name: duration
props.description: Undo window in milliseconds. Hovering the button with a mouse pauses the clock.

props.name: resetAfter
props.description: Milliseconds after committing before the button returns to idle. null stays on the done state.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Called when the button is pressed and the undo window opens.

props.name: onCommit
props.description: Called when the window closes without an undo: do the real work here.

props.name: onUndo
props.description: Called when the action is undone.
